categories.name: Flash Light Crackers
categories.blurb: Single-sound crackers. The opening line of every Diwali morning.

categories.name: Deluxe Crackers
categories.blurb: Louder single shots in deluxe wrap, sold by the packet and the box.

categories.name: Bijili Crackers
categories.blurb: Thin paper crackers by the bagful. Cheap, loud, endless.

categories.name: Flower Pots
categories.blurb: Cone fountains that sit on the ground and throw a steady spray of sparks.

categories.name: Mud Pots
categories.blurb: Clay-bodied fountains. Slower burn, wider bloom, no plastic.

categories.name: Twinkling Stars
categories.blurb: Hand-held whips that crackle white. Safe enough for the youngest cousins.

categories.name: Chakkarams
categories.blurb: Ground wheels that spin flat and fast. Give them a clean patch of floor.

categories.name: Bomb Crackers
categories.blurb: Sound crackers, quarter kilo up to one kilo. Open space only.

categories.name: Kids Special
categories.blurb: Ring caps, guns and novelty boxes for children — noise without fire.

categories.name: Rockets
categories.blurb: Stick rockets that climb before they burst. Launch from a bottle, never by hand.

categories.name: Colour Fountain Mega
categories.blurb: Tall colour fountains, the centrepiece of the evening.

categories.name: Multifunction Fountains
categories.blurb: One cone, several effects in sequence.

categories.name: Fancy Fireworks
categories.blurb: Novelty pieces — butterflies, saucers, helicopters, smoke.

categories.name: Single Shots
categories.blurb: One heavy shot per tube. Big bloom, short show.

categories.name: Whistling Series
categories.blurb: Pieces that scream before they burst.

categories.name: Repeating Shots
categories.blurb: Multi-shot tubes that fire in a run from a single fuse.

categories.name: Multicolour Shots
categories.blurb: Aerial cakes in mixed colour, 30 shots and up.

categories.name: Multicolour Shots — Premium
categories.blurb: Joker-brand aerial cakes, 15 to 240 shots.

categories.name: Sparklers
categories.blurb: Wire sparklers from 10cm to 50cm, in electric, colour, green and red.

categories.name: Continuous Crackers
categories.blurb: Sound garlands from 100 to 10,000 wala.

categories.name: Continuous Crackers — Jokkar
categories.blurb: Sound garlands from 100 to 10,000 wala.

categories.name: Special Items
categories.blurb: The odd and the theatrical — money showers, magic boxes, fire eggs.

combos.name: Kids Safe Box
combos.tagline: Nothing in here goes above waist height
combos.blurb: Sparklers, ground wheels and cap guns only. No aerial shots, no sound crackers above a clap. Built for a terrace with small children on it.

combos.name: Family Evening
combos.tagline: One household, one evening, nothing left over
combos.blurb: The standard order most families end up at: a spread of ground pieces and fountains, a few aerials to close, and enough sparklers to go round twice.

combos.name: Full Street
combos.tagline: When the whole lane bursts together
combos.blurb: Sound garlands, paper bombs and repeating shots in quantity. Assumes an open road, a bucket of sand and at least four adults watching.

combos.name: Sky Premium
combos.blurb: The high end of the list — premium Joker cakes, single shots and the big fountains. This is the box you buy when the whole family is home.
